description: A detective sits at a desk in a dim office, close-up with dramatic side lighting.

spec.subject: A tired male detective in his late 40s, average build, wearing a rumpled dark wool suit, white dress shirt with the collar open, loosened tie, and a slightly worn fedora resting out of frame; short dark hair with gray at the temples, a rough jawline, and faint under-eye shadows.
spec.setting: Dim private office at night; only a narrow sliver of desk edge and the blurred suggestion of stacked files and a desk lamp base are visible at the frame edges, with the rest falling into darkness.
spec.action: He sits still at the desk, head angled slightly down as if thinking.
spec.camera_angle: front three-quarter view, eye level, close-up, 85mm lens, the detective’s face and upper shoulders centered slightly off to the left.
spec.lighting: Dramatic low-key side lighting from a warm desk lamp
spec.style: Digital capture with restrained grain, muted blue-black shadows, warm skin tones, and a noir-inspired hard side-lighting setup with deep contrast and clean facial detail.
